operating_notes.text: Bank raised Tier II capital of ₹750 Cr during FY26.
Bank paid ₹6.36 Cr to buy PSLCs in FY26 and realised ₹4.16 Cr from PSLC sales in Q4FY26.
Bank transferred NPAs of ₹56,539.88 lakh principal to ARCs for ₹18,400 lakh consideration in FY26.
Bank raised Tier II capital of ₹50,000 lakh during the half year ended September 30, 2026.
Total business crossed ₹1 lakh crore during the quarter ended September 2026.
Unsecured microfinance is approximately 10% of advances.
Branch network stands at approximately 1,100 branches.
Gross advances crossed ₹50,000 Cr reaching ₹50,669 Cr (30% YoY growth); deposits reached ₹52,483 Cr (19% YoY growth).
Credit cost declined to 0.94% in Q2FY27 from 1.37% in Q1FY27 (1.12% excluding ARC transaction).
Mobilized $110 Mn of FCNR(B) deposits during the quarter, taking total FCNR(B) book to $138 Mn.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): interest earned ₹1,836.35 Cr (+11.7% YoY), net profit ₹212.68 Cr (+405.1% YoY).
Equitas Small Finance Bank Limited hosted an earnings call on May 02, 2026, at 11:00 A.M. with **N. Ramanathan**, MD & CEO, to discuss audited financial results for Q4FY26 and FY2026.
Equitas Small Finance Bank’s representatives will meet analysts and investors at roadshows on May 18–19, 2026, in Mumbai.
2026-06-01: Equitas Small Finance Bank received RBI approval for Mirae Asset Mutual Fund to acquire up to 9.5% stake.
Equitas Small Finance Bank Limited schedules Analyst/Investor Meet 2026 on June 11, 2026, from 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM at Trident BKC, Mumbai.
Equitas Small Finance Bank Limited will hold an earnings call on October 29, 2026 at 05:30 PM.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): interest earned ₹2,066 Cr (+27.7% YoY), net profit ₹218.04 Cr (+803.2% YoY).
P. N. Vasudevan resigned as MD & CEO of Equitas Small Finance Bank on October 29, 2026, to address investor concerns over a perceived conflict of interest.
Equitas SFB raised FY27 RoA guidance to ~1.35%, grew gross advances 30% YoY to ₹50,669 Cr, and lowered GNPA to 2.29%.
Equitas Small Finance Bank Limited provided a web link to the audio recording of its earnings call held on October 29, 2026 at 05:30 P.M.

Equitas Small Finance Bank Limited’s representatives, including **Ramanathan**, will attend an institutional investor conference on **November 5, 2026**, hosted by Ashika Stock Group & Investor Services in Mumbai.
Representatives of Equitas Small Finance Bank Limited will meet existing/prospective investors and analysts at a Non-Deal Roadshow on 10 November 2026 in Mumbai.
